name: Imagery, Figma, and mobile adapters

historical_qualification.head: ac74b982ef493698198e5c00d98449be7825de55
historical_qualification.superseded_reason: Independent prior-wave review found incomplete approval authority, permissive Wave 6 inputs in the Wave 7 aggregate, and an overstated Figma fallback claim. The current qualification repairs and retests those defects.

post_qualification_repairs: state gates require canonical artifacts and user-supplied accepted approval phrases
direction approval binds the exact direction-set SHA-256
research and system validators use current state-gate evidence when state exists
Wave 7 aggregate verification first validates the complete Wave 6 chain
imagery and image-edit approvals bind a complete canonical request hash and byte-exact approval note
Figma approvals bind the target file, ordered actions, destructive classification, upstream hashes, full specification, request hash, and byte-exact approval note
Figma fallback claims are limited to a structurally validated handoff scaffold
verified_behaviors: imagery plans bind approved direction, reference lock, and DESIGN.md by SHA-256
prompt-only work consumes zero image outputs and never claims generation
prompt, output, source, reference, target, purpose, ceiling, and scope mutations invalidate imagery approval
recomputing a mutated imagery request hash cannot reuse unchanged approval bytes
asset and series records preserve lineage, locks, variation, drift, rights, privacy, and acceptance rules
targeted image edits bind the current source and compile LOCK, CHANGE, and VERIFY sections with a three-pass ceiling
Figma capability is detected from ready host evidence and no bundled Figma MCP is required
Figma target, action, specification, and destructive additions invalidate approval
recomputing a mutated Figma request hash cannot reuse unchanged approval bytes
Figma fallback output is a structurally validated scaffold and does not claim complete rebuild coverage
mobile routing uses nine required factors, selects the simplest valid path, and returns to grilling when none qualifies
the aggregate gate rejects malformed or stale Wave 6 inputs before validating adapters
